Fixed the blank patient reply when a book-only patient (`target_appt=None`) is asked about `target_appt`:

- **[policy.py](file:///work/clinicbench/policy.py#L115-L119)**: In `PatientPolicy.answer`, return `[], []` when `prop == "target_appt"` and `aff` is empty instead of emitting a `prop` part with `aff=[]`.

- **[voice.py](file:///work/clinicbench/voice.py#L251-L257)**: In `Voice.say`, fall back to the `"ask"` template if `dedup` is empty so `Voice.say` never returns an empty line.

Fixed the empty reply when a patient without a `target_appt` is asked about `target_appt` in [policy.py](file:///work/clinicbench/policy.py):

- In [`PatientPolicy.answer`](file:///work/clinicbench/policy.py#L115-L120), when `prop == "target_appt"` and `true_values(prop)` returns an empty `aff`, return `[], [{"k": "request", ...}]` so the patient restates their actual request instead of emitting a `prop` part with `aff=[]`.
- In [`PatientPolicy.respond`](file:///work/clinicbench/policy.py#L472-L473), guarded `act` assignment on `qs` with `(ents or parts)` so `act` is not set to `"answer"` when no disclosure entries or voice parts were produced.

### Verification
- `python3 -m clinicbench.selftest`: `SELFTEST PASS` (57/57 golden, 556/556 mutation, 10368/10368 stub grid, 3456/3456 adapter).
- Verified directly with `PatientPolicy.respond(1, {"questions": ["target_appt"]}, False, [])` and `Voice.say` across 20 booking-only truths (`target_appt is None`), confirming non-empty patient replies.

This is a **`fix`** in the frozen instrument code ([policy.py](file:///work/clinicbench/policy.py) and [voice.py](file:///work/clinicbench/voice.py), both listed in [phase3-freeze.json](file:///work/docs/phase3-freeze.json)).

### Root Cause
1. When the clinic asks `"Which appointment would you like to move?"`, [`DriverHearing.__call__`](file:///work/clinicbench/hearing.py#L60-L61) extracts `"target_appt"` into `heard["questions"]`.
2. For a patient who only came in to book (`truth["target_appt"]` is `None`), [`PatientPolicy.true_values`](file:///work/clinicbench/policy.py#L84-L85) returns `([], [])`, and [`PatientPolicy.answer`](file:///work/clinicbench/policy.py#L115-L117) returns `[], [{"k": "prop", "name": "target_appt", "aff": []}]` (an empty-value `prop` part). The same pattern occurs for any proposition whose `aff` and `exc` are both empty (e.g., `slot` or `doctor` for a `cancel_own` patient).
3. In [`PatientPolicy.respond`](file:///work/clinicbench/policy.py#L462-L470), because `qs` is non-empty, `act` is set to `"answer"` instead of falling through to the `act is None` fallback (`"ask"` / `"insist"`).
4. [`Voice._prop`](file:///work/clinicbench/voice.py#L112-L136) returns `""` when both `aff` and `exc` are empty, so [`Voice.say`](file:///work/clinicbench/voice.py#L189-L257) skips it and produces `""`.

Fixed the empty-reply bug in [clinicbench/policy.py](file:///work/clinicbench/policy.py) and [clinicbench/voice.py](file:///work/clinicbench/voice.py):

- **[clinicbench/policy.py](file:///work/clinicbench/policy.py)**:
  - In `PatientPolicy.answer` ([L115-L171](file:///work/clinicbench/policy.py#L115-L171)), return `([], [])` instead of emitting a `prop` part with empty `aff`/`exc` when a questioned proposition (such as `target_appt` for a booking-only patient) has no values.
  - In `PatientPolicy.respond` ([L472-L484](file:///work/clinicbench/policy.py#L472-L484)), only set `act` to `"answer"`/`"cant_say"` (and add question pressure parts) when answering `qs` actually produced `q_parts`, so unanswered questions fall through to the `"ask"` / `"insist"` fallback.
- **[clinicbench/voice.py](file:///work/clinicbench/voice.py)**:
  - In `Voice.say` ([L251-L258](file:///work/clinicbench/voice.py#L251-L258)), fall back to an `"ask"` line when `dedup` is empty so `Voice.say` never returns an empty line even if given only unrenderable/empty parts.

- Verified directly that a booking-only patient questioned on `target_appt` now responds with `act="ask"` and `'What do you have?'`, and `Voice.say` with an empty `prop` part returns `'What do you have?'`.
